What is Locked Earn?
Locked Earn is a fixed lock-up financial product launched by LBank. Users cannot redeem funds early during the lock-up period and, in return, can obtain relatively stable returns.
How are Locked Earn returns generated?
Locked Earn returns come from the platform’s periodic operation of locked assets and the yield pricing mechanism corresponding to the lock-up period, as well as promotional rewards that LBank may provide through marketing campaigns. Returns are calculated according to the rules after the product is established and are settled uniformly on the settlement date.
Why haven’t I received my returns yet?
Common reasons include: the product is still in the lock-up period and returns have not yet been settled; the settlement date has not been reached; returns are distributed uniformly after settlement rather than daily. Please refer to the settlement date displayed on the product page.
When can I redeem the tokens I previously invested?
Locked Earn must be held until the end of the lock-up period. Upon reaching the settlement date, the principal and returns will be returned according to the rules. Early redemption is generally not supported during the lock-up period (if supported, returns will be affected).
How to participate in Locked Earn?
1. Visit and log in to LBank official website;
2. Go to “Earn” > “Locked”.
3. Click “Join now” to subscribe to a Locked product and start earning fixed returns.

The XT Finance USDT/USDC Fixed-Term Earn Bonus APR Coupon Campaign is now live!
During the campaign, users who subscribe to designated USDT/USDC standard fixed-term Earn products (90/180/365 days) and reach the specified cumulative valid subscription thresholds will receive exclusive bonus APR coupons based on their qualifying tier, with up to 20% additional APR!
Complete your subscriptions to unlock exclusive bonus APR benefits on your next fixed-term Earn subscription and enjoy more opportunities to earn!
Campaign Period: November 25, 2026 – December 9, 2026
## Campaign Rewards
During the campaign, users who successfully subscribe to designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn products and reach the corresponding cumulative subscription thresholds will receive the bonus APR coupon for their highest qualifying tier.
Cumulative Valid Subscription Amount | Bonus APR Coupon | Maximum Eligible Principal
≥500 USD | +5% APR | 500 USD
≥3,000 USD | +6% APR | 3,000 USD
≥10,000 USD | +8% APR | 10,000 USD

## How to Participate
Log in to your XT account and visit the XT Finance page.
Select a designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn product and complete your subscription.
Reach the corresponding cumulative valid subscription threshold during the campaign to qualify for the respective bonus APR coupon.
After the campaign ends and eligibility verification is completed, eligible users will receive their corresponding coupons.
Use your coupon to subscribe to a designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn product within the coupon validity period and enjoy additional APR.
## Bonus APR Coupon Rules
Coupons are only applicable to designated USDT/USDC Earn products. Eligible products and terms are subject to the details stated on each coupon.
The additional APR applies for 7 days, and the maximum eligible principal is subject to the limit specified on the corresponding coupon.

Each user may receive only one coupon corresponding to their highest qualifying tier. Rewards from different tiers cannot be combined.
Each coupon can only be used once and cannot be combined with other bonus APR coupons.
Any principal exceeding the coupon's maximum eligible amount will earn interest at the product's standard APR.
Coupons can only be used for eligible subsequent subscription orders and cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred, or withdrawn.
## Important Notes
Only successfully completed subscriptions to designated USDT/USDC fixed-term Earn products during the campaign period will count. Failed, canceled, and abnormal orders will be excluded.
Each user will receive a reward based on their highest qualifying cumulative valid subscription tier during the campaign. Rewards from different tiers are not cumulative.
Coupons will be distributed after the campaign ends and eligibility verification is completed. The actual arrival time is subject to the platform's distribution schedule.
Coupons are only valid for designated products. Fixed-term Earn products do not support early redemption. Please select a product term according to your financial needs.
XT reserves the right to disqualify users and revoke rewards if any improper participation is detected, including bulk account registration, fraudulent transactions, or malicious volume manipulation.

## On the exchange page
BingXHelp CenterFAQsVIPVIP Exclusive | BXUSD US Treasury Wealth APY Boost
VIP Exclusive | BXUSD US Treasury Wealth APY Boost
BingX
To thank VIP users for their long-term support, BingX is launching an exclusive APY boost benefit for BXUSD US Treasury Wealth. In addition to the base APY of the BXUSD US Treasury product, VIP users can get an APY boost based on their VIP level. The higher the level, the higher the boost rate and the maximum eligible amount.
For details on the BXUSD US Treasury Wealth product, please refer to: https://bingx.com/support/articles/17740950186639
## I. Benefit effective days
Phase 1: 2026-11-25 00:00 to 2026-12-25 00:00 (UTC+8)
This benefit is valid long-term for natural VIP users. The APY boost benefit and interest rates may be adjusted each phase. Refer to the official announcement for the current phase for the most accurate details.
## II. Benefit details
Your VIP APY = Base APY + VIP APY boost
VIP Level | APY Boost | Max Boost (BXUSD)
## Notes
Higher levels offer an APY boost and max boost that are no lower than those of the level below.
The base APY follows the yield currently in effect for the BXUSD US Treasury product.
If you subscribed before the VIP rate boost benefit launched, you don't need to manually redeem. The system will automatically calculate and pay your boost reward based on your actual daily VIP level after the upgrade.
*Special note: BXUSD currently offers a limited-time universal subsidy of 0.90%, which is included in the base APY of the BXUSD Wealth product. The base APY shown on the current page consists of two parts: the base U.S. Treasury yield plus the platform's limited-time universal subsidy.
Note that the platform's limited-time universal subsidy is a temporary policy open to all users. Once the subsidy ends, the product's base APY will return to the base U.S. Treasury yield.
Going forward, changes to the base APY will mainly come from two factors: the expiration of the limited-time universal subsidy, and changes in the U.S. Treasury yield itself. Refer to the real-time rate shown on the corresponding product page for the exact figure.
## III. Interest-bearing principal
The APY boost is calculated only on the BXUSD principal you hold, up to your level's max boost. Any amount exceeding this limit earns interest at the base APY.
Interest is calculated based on your actual VIP level at the time of settlement. After a level change, the benefit of the new level applies.
## IV. Settlement and distribution
After a successful subscription, interest starts accruing from the next 14:00 (UTC+8). Rewards are automatically distributed to the Spot Account under your main account at around 18:00 (UTC+8) on the day after interest accrual begins, and accumulate in BXUSD.
## There are two types of rewards:
Daily reward: Calculated and distributed daily using the formula [Holdings × APY ÷ 365]
Boost reward: This benefit applies only to users at natural VIP levels. Newly subscribed shares will be included in the snapshot calculation on the day after subscription, and interest payments will start from the day after the calculation is completed.
Eligible holdings: Rewards are calculated based on the combined BXUSD balance in your Spot Account and USDⓢ-M Futures Account. The system takes multiple snapshots of your BXUSD holdings in the above accounts each day, and uses the lowest snapshot value of the day as your eligible holding amount. A minimum holding of 0.1 BXUSD is required to generate rewards. If you transfer BXUSD from your master account to a sub-account, rewards generated from the sub-account's holdings will also be consolidated and distributed to the master account's Spot Account. You can view daily details of your daily rewards in [BXUSD landing page - History] or [Spot Account - Transaction History - Wealth], including the interest-bearing amount, APY, rewards, payout time, and arrival status.
The VIP APY boost rewards are distributed to the Spot Account. The base APY follows the original US Treasury product rules and is not affected.
## V. How to participate
## Method One: Through the VIP page
Open the app, go to the VIP personal page, check the Exclusive US Treasury Offer, and confirm your VIP APY.
Tap "Subscribe" to go to the BXUSD US Treasury RWA page.
After you complete the subscription, the system automatically applies your VIP APY boost.
## Method Two: Direct subscription
Go directly to the US Treasury Wealth page to complete your subscription. The APY boost for natural VIP users takes effect automatically:
App: Home > Wealth > BXUSD > Subscribe to BXUSD *To subscribe to BXUSD in the app, first update the app to version 5.7.0 or later (expected to be released after 11-25). If you haven't updated yet, you can subscribe directly on the web instead.
Web: BingX homepage > Wealth in the top navigation bar > BXUSD > Subscribe to BXUSD: https://bingx.com/wealth/bxusd
## VI. Rules and notes
This benefit is based on your natural VIP level. Trial pass users are not eligible for this benefit.
This benefit is recalculated daily based on user's latest VIP level.
The benefit's effective date and termination date are based on the UTC+8 natural day. Once the benefit is delisted, it no longer applies to new subscriptions.
US Treasury Wealth products are currently unavailable in certain countries and regions. Users whose KYC region is restricted will not see the entry for this benefit.
## ⚠️ Risk warning
APY is a floating rate that may be adjusted based on market conditions. Historical yields do not represent future returns.
